goal: Owner-uploaded Contacts/visits CSV ingestion with per-upload blocking Consent attestation per the locked #535 contract: async csv_ingest outbox lane parses/validates/dedupes rows into per-location Contact + Visit rows (normalized handle computed once at ingest), tenant-scoped reads, per-contact hard delete, offboarding purge sweep.
non_goals: Batch trigger (solicitation_batches INSERT + build_solicitation_batch outbox row at ingest completion) — #543 extends the completion transaction
solicitation_batches / solicitation_asks tables and run-spine widening — #543
Batch review UI, env staging flip of SOLICITATION_WATCH_ENABLED — #544 (this ticket registers the flag, default OFF everywhere)
Suppression ledger (only the normalized-handle commitment is honored)
Per-row consent columns or any consent-ledger model (send-mode + counsel)
Any send path, veto window, or ask copy
user_visible_behavior: New /dashboard/contacts page, rendered only when server-side SOLICITATION_WATCH_ENABLED is on (flag state learned via API, invariant #13)
CSV upload with a blocking Consent attestation checkbox (versioned attestation-text code constant); no upload without it
Processing status, then ingest report: contacts created/merged, visits added, duplicate_visit count, rejected rows as {row, reason} with download
Partial accept: valid rows land even when others reject; whole-file structural failures import nothing
Contact list with per-contact hard delete (visits CASCADE)
Re-uploading an overlapping export is idempotent: no duplicate visits, non-empty notes refresh
invariants: #1 Vercel = UI only: route persists upload row + outbox job; ALL parsing/matching/upserts run in the Railway csv_ingest worker
#2 Transactional outbox: upload row + csv_ingest job_outbox row in ONE transaction; report write + raw-CSV NULLing in ONE transaction
#8 Tenant scoping: every read/write scoped by account_id and business_id; contacts keyed (business_id, normalized handle)
#11 Worker gates on subscriptionGrantsFullAccess, never raw === 'active'
#13 Server-authoritative flag: SOLICITATION_WATCH_ENABLED has NO NEXT_PUBLIC companion
#15 Domain modules under src/lib/solicitation take sql/tx as explicit parameter; only composition roots import the DB singleton
Raw CSV text is NULLed in the same transaction as the terminal report (success or terminal failure); metadata (filename, bytes, SHA-256, counts, report, attestation) retained
Never auto-merge two existing contacts (ambiguous_identity rejects)
Normalization happens once at ingest; stored normalized handle is the future suppression join key (never contact_id)
Never log raw CSV content, handles, names, or notes (PII) — counts and reasons only
Migration 086 is purely additive: no existing table touched
edge_cases: Row's email matches contact X, phone matches contact Y → reject ambiguous_identity
Matched contact lacking the row's second handle → merge it in; name difference → latest non-empty wins
Duplicate (contact_id, visit_date) → count duplicate_visit; non-empty incoming note refreshes stored note
10-digit phone assumed US → E.164; unparseable → invalid_phone
last_visit_date accepts YYYY-MM-DD and MM/DD/YYYY; future date → future_date
Unknown columns ignored; header aliases matched case-insensitively; missing required header → whole-file reject
>5 MB or >5,000 data rows or undecodable encoding → whole-file reject, nothing imported
Old visit dates are VALID (staleness is restraint-policy's judgment, not ingest's)
Flag off → page hidden and API routes 404
Multi-location account → upload targets one selected business_id
Worker retry after partial failure must be idempotent (visit dedupe + handle merge are natural upserts)
note over length cap → note_too_long row rejection
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/admin/csv-import.ts — hand-rolled CSV parse, CsvRowFailure/report shape, bounds constants (no new parser dependency)
src/lib/shared/queue-names.ts + ci:outbox-topics — topic registration for csv_ingest
src/lib/solicitation/restraint-policy.ts — module + __tests__ style for the new domain files
src/app/(authenticated)/dashboard/** — page conventions; repworth-brand-design skill for the UI
supabase/migrations/084_competitor_snapshots.sql — recent additive-migration style; UUIDv7 PK convention per migrations-log

latest non-empty name wins on a matched contact

rejects the whole file when data rows exceed the 5,000-row cap

estimated_diff_size: +2000-2500 / -0 (greenfield subsystem: migration ~120, domain modules ~700, worker job ~300, API routes ~350, dashboard page ~450, tests ~700). Net-positive justified: new domain with no prior code.
rollback_plan: Migration 086 is additive-only (contact_csv_uploads, solicitation_contacts, solicitation_visits; no existing-table changes). Back-out order: (1) SOLICITATION_WATCH_ENABLED stays/returns OFF (default) — surface unreachable; (2) revert the PR; (3) if schema must go, drop the three tables in reverse FK order (visits → contacts → uploads) via a down migration, staging Supabase first, prod in lockstep. No data backfill to unwind while flag was never flipped in prod.
observability: csv_ingest worker logs (createWorkerLogger, correlationId) at start/terminal with row counts and rejection-reason histogram — never row content
Upload row carries the terminal report + timestamps: 'did ingest finish and what happened' is a DB query
Ingest failure path writes terminal failure onto the upload row and surfaces via Sentry (worker error capture); stuck csv_ingest outbox rows covered by the existing outbox watchdog
Broken-in-prod signal: uploads stuck in processing status (report never written) or Sentry csv_ingest errors
